page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top centre. Two epitaph blocks of verse separated by decorative rules, each with a heading; no margin notes; no page number printed.

main_text.p: Laudata Siuit, factaque posteri Liuore mirantur perempto Pierius celebrata chordis.
main_text.head: FRANCISCO LANOEO HEROI.

p.i: Laneum quisquis conclamas morte iacentem, Falleris: Heroum stat sine fine decus. Viuus enim qui sex Siguitque stetitque columnis, Mortuus hic nulla morte iacere potest. Hinc pietas, doctrina, fides, prudentia, robur Mentis, & in patria non simulatus amor Lanoeum caeliftellis ardentibus aptant, Et stantem nulla parte iacere sinunt.

main_text.head: IOACHIMI CAMERARII Germani, Pabembergensis, Græcæ Linguæ & Philosophiæ Professoris celeberrimi Lipsiæ, Memoriæ

p.i: Extinctus olim, Musæ, fleuistis alumnis, Et vitam Vestra restitutis ope. Nos contra Vobis, Ioachimi in funere, Musæ, Has miseri extinctas soluimus exequias. Namque omnes tecum, tecum, Ioachime, Camænæ Vt Svixere simul, sic periere simul.

page.notes: Several words in the verses are heavily worn; "Siguit" and "Svixere" and "Pabembergensis" are uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout. The Greek letters in the first line are not distinguishable and the heading text is transcribed as printed.
